summary: Perturbation kinetic energy budget of the two Floquet modes of the flip-flop orbit at Re = 62. It reproduces the Floquet exponent.
description: Orbit-averaged perturbation kinetic energy budget (userParam01 = 4.11) of the two Floquet modes of the flip-flop orbit at Re = 62. The period T = 8.815129 is the time stamp of BF_2cyl0.f00001. The budget must reproduce the Floquet exponent of stage 311, 7.900166e-3 (row 1 of Spectre_NSd_conv.dat): sigma = (P - D - S)/(2 E) with the production P, the dissipation D and the sponge damping S averaged over one orbit. With the weak-form dissipation nu int |grad q|^2 it closes to 0.40 % (1.2 % with the strong form q . lap q on an earlier orbit); the rest is first order in dt. The exponent from the energy of the marched mode after one period (no space derivative in it) is within 0.11 % of the eigenvalue. Without the sponge term the budget gave 8.478e-3 (7.4 % above, earlier orbit) and fails the first two quantities. The sponge loss and the three field statistics are regression values of the run.

sigma_budget_mode1.note: sigma reconstructed from the budget of mode 1 (line 14 of PKE_floquet_2cyl0.f00001) against the Floquet exponent of stage 311. Measured 7.9320e-3, 0.40 % above.

sigma_budget_mode2.note: The same for mode 2, the complex conjugate of mode 1, which has the same exponent.

sigma_energy_mode1.note: sigma from ln(E(T)/E(0))/(2T) of the marched mode (line 16). Measured 7.8914e-3, 0.11 % below: the mode is an eigenvector of the monodromy over the period of the base flow.

sponge_loss_mode1.note: Sponge damping S of mode 1 (line 15), the term the first version of the budget left out.

production_vx_max.note: Largest value of the first stored production component of mode 1 (x-derivative of the base flow, x-momentum).

production_vy_max.note: Largest value of the second stored production component of mode 1 (x-derivative of the base flow, y-momentum).

production_y_derivative_vy_min.note: Smallest value of the y-momentum production component for the y-derivative of the base flow, mode 1.
